fixtures.name: commander_cast
assertions: commander begins in command-zone semantics
a legal commander cast is exposed/accepted through provider control
post-resolution/counter state is observable

fixtures.name: commander_tax
assertions: third command-zone cast carries +4 generic commander tax
printed five-mana commander therefore requires total cost nine absent other modifiers

fixtures.name: partner_commanders
assertions: both legal partners occupy command-zone commander roles
casting one partner does not erase the other
per-commander cast/tax identity remains distinct

fixtures.name: per_opponent_commander_damage
assertions: commander combat damage is tracked by commander and damaged opponent
21 from one commander to one opponent causes that opponent to lose
damage to different opponents is not combined

fixtures.name: kediss_normal_damage
assertions: commander combat damage to one opponent creates Kediss trigger
each other opponent takes matching noncombat damage
Kediss damage adds zero commander damage

fixtures.name: jeska_multiplier
assertions: Jeska effect triples applicable commander combat damage to the chosen opponent
7 applicable combat damage becomes 21 actual damage
because the damage is dealt by the commander, 21 commander damage is tracked

fixtures.name: boardwipe
assertions: wipe applies to all applicable creatures
indestructible protection prevents destroy/lethal-damage destruction where rules allow
resulting zones are observable

fixtures.name: counter
assertions: counter response can be submitted in a legal priority window
countered spell does not resolve
state/stack transition is observable

fixtures.name: protection
assertions: indestructible survives applicable destroy/lethal-damage effects
indestructible does not prevent zero-or-less toughness
provider distinguishes these outcomes

fixtures.name: trigger
assertions: cast trigger is created on casting
countering the triggering spell does not retroactively remove the already-created trigger
trigger/stack evidence is observable

fixtures.name: replacement
assertions: a deterministic replacement-choice scenario produces a provider choice point or deterministic auto-choice
chosen replacement modifies the event before normal processing
raw state/trace shows replaced outcome

fixtures.name: stack_priority
assertions: priority passes are controllable/observable enough to reach response windows
stack ordering is observable
submitted action is tied to the current choice/state revision

fixtures.name: illegal_action_rejection
assertions: an action not legal in the current provider state is rejected
rejection does not mutate game state
rejection has machine-capturable evidence

fixtures.name: replay_state_consistency
assertions: provider replay or equivalent raw trace preserves ordered externally relevant transitions
reconstructed/checkpoint state agrees with captured live state at defined checkpoints
unknown/unmapped events cannot be silently discarded when they affect state
